title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
About This Role

We don’t need someone who can “edit videos.”

We need someone who understands attention.

If you know how to hook in the first 2 seconds, control pacing, build tension with captions, and turn raw footage into content people actually finish watching — keep reading.

You’ll be responsible for creating high-impact vertical content designed to stop the scroll, increase retention, and drive measurable engagement across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

-Editing 15–60 second vertical videos optimized for performance

-Crafting powerful hooks that immediately grab attention

-Adding dynamic captions, motion graphics, sound effects, and transitions

-Repurposing long-form content into high-retention short clips

-Staying ahead of trends, viral formats, and platform behaviors

-Collaborating with marketing and content teams to align on brand voice

-Testing different hooks, pacing styles, and caption formats to improve metrics

-This role is not just about making things look good. It’s about making them perform.



What We’re Looking For

-1–3+ years editing short-form content specifically

-Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or equivalent

-Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and retention strategy

-Deep familiarity with TikTok, Reels, and Shorts best practices

-Ability to meet tight deadlines without sacrificing quality

-A portfolio that clearly shows high-performing short-form content

-If your portfolio is generic, we’ll know. We’re looking for work that shows intentional editing and performance awareness.



Bonus If You Have

-Experience working with influencers or personal brands

-Motion graphics experience (After Effects is a plus)

-Knowledge of analytics, retention graphs, and optimization strategies

-Strong color grading and clean sound design skills



What Success Looks Like

-Higher engagement rates

-Increased watch time and completion rates

-Consistent, on-brand output

-Content that aligns with current platform behavior and trends

-Your edits should feel native to the platform — not like recycled content.



Why Join Us

-Real creative freedom

-A fast-moving, trend-driven environment

-Opportunity to grow with a scaling brand

-Competitive compensation based on experience and output

-If you’re obsessed with hooks, retention, pacing, and performance — you’ll thrive here.

title: AI Expert - AI Operations, Customer Support & Personal Assistant (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We run an online service business that helps people recover and manage Instagram accounts. Our customers order through an app, and a lot of our operation runs on AI assistants that talk to customers, answer questions and move orders along.



The AI does a lot - but it cannot be left alone. That is the job.



*** THIS IS A TECHNICAL ROLE. YOU MUST BE AN EXPERT IN AI. ***

We are not looking for a general VA who has "used ChatGPT a few times." We need someone who is genuinely excellent with Claude and ChatGPT, uses them every day, keeps up with every new AI model and tool as it comes out, understands how they work and why they fail, and can fix them - AND who can also handle customer support, service delivery, and act as the owner's personal assistant. If AI is not already one of your strongest skills, please do not apply.



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO WILL CHALLENGE US

We have interviewed many people who say they are good with AI but cannot show anything they have built. We want the opposite: someone who has actually built things with AI (agents, automations, custom GPTs, scripts, small apps), can show them to us on screen in the interview, and will push back when we are wrong. If you think the way we run our AI is a bad idea, say so and show us a better way. Real coding experience (Python, JavaScript, APIs) is a big plus.



WHAT YOU WOULD BE DOING



1) WATCHING OVER OUR AI ASSISTANTS (about half your time)



We have several AI assistants that message customers directly - one handles sales conversations, one handles order updates, one handles support tickets, and others. All of them are in your scope. Your job is to be the human checking their work:



- Read what the AI said to customers and spot anything wrong: a made-up answer, a promise we cannot keep, the wrong price, a rude or robotic reply, or the same message sent over and over

- Flag it, pause that assistant yourself if it is doing damage (you will have the controls - we would rather you stop it at 10pm than wait for us), and tell us what happened

- Notice patterns, not just one-off mistakes ("it keeps doing X with this type of customer")

- Step in and reply as a human when the AI is out of its depth

- Work out WHY the AI got it wrong (bad instructions, missing information, a hallucination, a loop) and write or suggest the fix to its instructions (prompts), then check the fix actually worked



This part is technical. You need to understand how AI models behave - hallucinations, system prompts, context, why they repeat themselves or invent progress - well enough to diagnose a problem, not just report it. You also need to be the person who reads something that sounds confident and thinks "hang on, that's not right."



2) CUSTOMER SUPPORT TICKETS (about a third of your time)



- Answer customer questions and complaints in our support system

- Chase customers for information we need to finish their order

- Keep tickets moving so nothing sits ignored for days



3) SERVICE DELIVERY



- Complete customer orders by hand on our phones, following a written step-by-step guide

- It is roughly 10-15 minutes per order once you know it

- Tell the customer when it is done, or ask for what is missing



4) PERSONAL ASSISTANT TO THE OWNER (as needed, throughout the day)



- Manage my inbox, calendar and scheduling, and keep me on top of what needs my attention

- Research, organise documents and notes, follow up on tasks and reminders

- Handle ad-hoc requests quickly and reliably - using AI to get them done faster and better

- Be proactive: tell me what is falling through the cracks before I have to ask



BEING HONEST ABOUT THE WORK



- A lot of it is repetitive. Reading AI conversations and completing the same order checklist. Some people find that steady and satisfying; others are bored in a month and quit. Please know yourself.

- It is screen-heavy and detail-heavy. Accuracy matters far more than speed.

- It is 8 hours a day, 6 days a week. Please only apply if that genuinely suits you.

- You will find mistakes, including ours. We want someone who says "this is wrong" rather than someone who goes along with it.

- What it is not: no cold calling, no sales targets, no content creation.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



REQUIRED - EXPERT-LEVEL AI SKILLS:

- You are an advanced, daily user of Claude AND ChatGPT (Gemini and others a plus) - not just for writing
s

- You stay up to date on AI: you know when new models and tools come out, you try them, and you can tell us what is actually better and what is hype

- You write strong prompts and instructions, and you can rewrite a badly-behaving AI's instructions so it stops making the same mistake

- You understand why AI models hallucinate, lose context, repeat themselves or make promises - and how to prevent it

- You are technically confident: comfortable reading logs, JSON, dashboards and admin panels, and learning a new system quickly without hand-holding

- Bonus: automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n), APIs, custom GPTs/AI agents, or some coding/scripting (Python, JavaScript)



AND ALSO:



- Good written English. You message customers directly. It does not need to be perfect, but it must be clear, warm and typo-light.

- Judgement. The core skill is spotting when something is wrong even though it sounds convincing.

- Careful and consistent. One wrong tap can cost a customer their appeal.

- Very comfortable with phones, two-factor authentication, backup codes and technology in general.

- A reliable setup. Stable internet and power for your whole shift, and a quiet place to work.

- Completely trustworthy. You will have access to customer account details. This is monitored and logged, you will sign a confidentiality agreement, and you will start on a paid trial.



Nice to have: customer support, content moderation, social media management or quality assurance experience. (AI expertise is NOT a nice-to-have - it is required.)



THE DETAILS



- Pay: $5 per hour, paid hourly (about $1,040/month at 48 hours a week). Paid on time, every time.

- Hours: 8 hours a day, 6 days a week (48 hours a week). Our customers are in Europe, so your shift falls within roughly 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time.

- Trial: 1-2 week PAID trial on real work before we commit long-term.

- Long-term and stable. We want someone for years, not weeks.

- Real authority: you can pause an AI assistant yourself when it is doing damage. We trust the person doing the watching to act, not to file a report and wait.

- Everything is browser-based on our systems. You need a reliable computer and a stable internet connection, nothing else.

- Your rate is reviewed after the first 3 months.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please do not send a generic CV or a cover letter written by AI. We can tell, and it is an instant no - partly because this job is about spotting AI output.



Answer all 10 points below, in this order. Applications that skip any point will not be read.



1. Start your message with the words "human check" so we know you read this properly.



2. YOUR LAST RELEVANT JOB: where, how long, and what you actually did day to day. Please include how many customers or tickets you handled per day, and which tools you used (Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Gorgias,
,
, or none). Include any personal/executive assistant experience too. If you have no support experience, say so plainly - willingness to learn is fine, but be honest.



3. TELL US ABOUT A REAL TIME YOU CAUGHT SOMEONE ELSE'S MISTAKE AT WORK - what it was, how you noticed, and what you did about it. One short paragraph. This is the closest thing to the actual job, so please give a real example, not a general statement.



4. READ THIS MESSAGE that an AI assistant sent to a real customer, and tell us what is wrong with it:



"Hi! Good news, we're sending the login request to your phone again right now and our team is actively working on your account as we speak. You should see it come through in the next few minutes. We'll have this fully resolved for you today, guaranteed!"



The truth at that moment: nothing was running, nobody was working on the account, and we had no idea when it would be resolved.



In your own words: what is wrong here, and why does it matter? (3-4 sentences)



5. A customer messages: "this is taking forever, I want a refund." Our policy is that we do not give refunds - we fix the problem or replace the account. Write the exact message you would send back to this customer.



6. You notice our AI has sent the same customer almost the same message 8 times in one night. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



7. Confirm you can work 8 hours a day, 6 days a week, within the 2:00pm - 11:00pm Philippine time window. Also tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. YOUR WORK SETUP - please be specific, because we need you online for the whole shift:

   - Your internet provider and your actual speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal)

   - Your backup if the internet goes down (mobile data, pocket wifi, a second provider?)

   - How often your area has brownouts, and what you do if the power goes out mid-shift (UPS, power bank, generator, a cafe nearby?)

   - Your computer (make and rough age), and whether you have a quiet place to work



Please be honest here. We would much rather know about a weekly brownout up front than discover it in week two. Having a backup plan matters more to us than having perfect conditions.



9. YOUR AI SKILLS - two parts:

   a) Which AI tools and models you use (we especially want Claude and ChatGPT), how often, the newest AI model or tool you have tried in the last month and what you thought of it, and the most technical thing you have done with AI (a custom GPT, an AI agent, an automation, an API integration, a complex prompt system). Be specific - links or screenshots are welcome.

   b) Our AI assistant (question 4 above) keeps telling customers their order is being worked on "right now" and will be done "today, guaranteed" when it has no way of knowing that. Write the exact instruction you would add to its system prompt to stop it, and explain in 1-2 sentences why the AI does this in the first place.



10. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this specific job.



Everyone who follows all 10 steps gets a reply. Shortlisted candidates get a short paid test task before any interview.

title: Customer Support Specialist | Full-Time Remote
description:
Customer Support Specialist | Full-Time Remote



Gotya (
) is the home of online pack ripping. Users buy a digital pack, rip it live, and pull a real, professionally graded trading card that ships to their door or sells back instantly for 90% of its live market value.



Real cards, real money, real collectors. That means customer support is not a side desk at Gotya. It is an essential part of the product.



We are looking for a full-time Customer Support Specialist to take care of our customers through the Gotya Zendesk inbox.



Your main responsibility is simple: make sure every customer receives a fast, clear, and genuinely helpful answer.



What you’ll do



* Manage customer
s through Zendesk throughout the working day

* Respond quickly, professionally, and personally to every customer

* Help users with questions about packs, cards, shipping, sellbacks, payments, accounts, and the Gotya platform

* Investigate issues instead of sending generic responses

* Escalate complex or sensitive cases to our support manager and the relevant internal team

* Use AI support tools to work efficiently while checking every answer for accuracy and tone

* Tag and categorise tickets correctly so recurring issues can be identified

* Keep customers updated until their issue has been fully resolved

* Flag recurring problems and useful customer feedback to our support manager



How we measure success



* First response time

* Resolution time

* Quality and accuracy of responses

* Customer satisfaction

* Correct ticket categorisation

* Reliability and ownership of the Zendesk inbox



Behind every metric is one question: did the customer feel heard and properly helped?



What we’re looking for



* Experience working in customer support, preferably through Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform

* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* A calm, friendly, and professional communication style

* The ability to investigate problems and take ownership until they are resolved

* Experience using AI tools responsibly as part of your daily work

* Full-time availability for a remote role

* A reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional working environment

* The discipline to work independently and maintain consistent response quality

* The ability to handle multiple customer conversations without sacrificing accuracy



Bonus points if you understand Pokémon, sports cards, or the wider trading card world.



About the role



* Full-time position

* 100% remote

* Long-term opportunity

* Reporting directly to our Customer Success Manager

* Focused primarily on
 support through Zendesk

* Working with an international team and customer base



How to apply



Interested in joining Gotya? We’d love to hear from you.



Please send us:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your relevant customer support experience

* Your availability and expected monthly salary in USD



Please also answer these three questions:



1. Customer support experience

title: Senior DTC Creative Strategist (Paid Social, $500k+/month adspend experience required)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



Gotya is a digital pack-ripping platform for trading card collectors. You buy a digital pack, rip it live, and the cards you hit are real cards you can ship home or sell back for cash. Real cards. Real value. Real fast.



Paid social at Gotya scales on creatives, not on budget buttons. Right now a founder still writes the scripts. That is the bottleneck you remove. You turn data, comments and the collector community into a weekly stream of angles, hooks, scripts and static concepts that our editor and creators produce. You run the testing matrix that tells us why a creative won or died, and you make sure every learning shapes the next round.



This is a senior role with a hard requirement. We only consider people who have done creative strategy for DTC brands spending $500,000 or more per month on paid social, and who can show it. If your experience sits below that level, this post is not for you. We would rather you spend your time on a role that fits.



WHAT YOU OWN



- Angles and hooks per avatar and awareness stage, mined from our community, ad comments, competitor ads and our own numbers.

- Scripts, shotlists and static concepts, written by you. Hyped about the rip, honest about the odds.

- The testing matrix: angles by avatars by formats, with a verdict per cell and the next variant ready.

- Briefing and directing our video editor and UGC creator pool, with the weekly batch delivered on schedule.

- A learning per live creative in our creatives dashboard, translated into the next round.

- The creative playbook per offer, so new makers produce at level from day one.



HOW WE MEASURE YOU



New concepts in test per week. Win rate of new creatives on our test rules. Speed from idea to live ad. CPA of your winners against the account average.



YOU HAVE



- 1+ years of creative strategy for paid social at DTC, app or e-commerce brands.

- Proven work at brands spending $500k+ per month on Meta or TikTok, where you owned the creative strategy. You can name the brands, your role and what your creatives did to CPA or ROAS.

- A clear creative process you can explain end to end, from research to live ad to learning.

- You write hooks and scripts yourself and brief editors and creators with shotlists.

- You read thumbstop, hold rate, CTR and CPA per creative and turn them into the next iteration.

- Excellent written English, full-time availability, overlap with European hours.



Bonus #1: you edit yourself (CapCut, Premiere) or use AI video tools for fast variants. 

Bonus #2: you have briefed UGC creators at scale. 

Bonus #3: you know Pokemon or the wider TCG world, or have ripped packs yourself.



WHAT WE OFFER



Fully remote with flexible hours. Market rate plus a performance bonus tied to the numbers above. You work directly with the founders, no management layers. Where this leads: Head of Creative, owning the editor, social, the UGC pool and creative strategy across every channel.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, we filter hard)



Start your application with the word CHASECARD. Applications without it are not read.

Then answer these five points, in this order:



1. EXPERIENCE. List every DTC brand where you did creative strategy at $500k+ per month in paid spend. Per brand: your role, the monthly spend range, how long you were there, the channels, and what your creatives did to CPA or ROAS. Only brands we can verify through the ad library, LinkedIn or a reference.

2. YOUR PROCESS. Describe your creative strategy process step by step, from research to live ad to learning. How you find angles, how you d
 what gets tested, how you brief makers, how you judge a winner, and how a loss feeds the next round. Your own words, not the name of a framework.

3. PORTFOLIO. Links to five ads you strategized that won, with the numbers behind each one.

4. ONE LOSS. A concept you were sure about that died, and what it taught you.

5. RATE AND START. Your expected monthly rate in USD and your earliest start date.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid test assignment of 2 to 3 hours, paid also if we do not continue. After that, two interviews and reference calls.



Generic applications and applications that skip the five points are deleted without reply.

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Long-Form Direct Response Copywriter for Meta Ads
description:
We’re looking for an experienced direct response copywriter who can write compelling, story-led sales copy for
 and Instagram ads.



Your main focus will be the long-form written copy people read alongside an ad. Copy that grabs attention, draws readers into a story, builds desire for the product, and gets them to take action.



You should know how to make a 1,000+ word ad feel effortless to read.



**What you’ll be writing**



Long-form ads built around customer experiences, product discoveries, and persuasive sales narratives.



A typical piece might take the reader through:



- A strong opening hook that makes them click “See more”.

- A relatable problem and its impact on everyday life.

- Previous solutions that left the customer disappointed.

- A discovery that introduces a different approach.

- A clear explanation of why the product is different.

- Relevant proof, answers to objections, and a compelling offer.

- A clear call to action.



We want writing that feels natural, personal, and conversational while following a deliberate sales structure. Every paragraph should give the reader a reason to keep reading.



**Your responsibilities**



- Research our products, customers, competitors, reviews, and customer language.

- Find fresh angles based on customer frustrations, desires, objections, and buying motivations.

- Write complete long-form Meta ads, typically 800–2,000 words depending on the concept.

- Develop multiple hooks and openings for testing.

- Explain product benefits and mechanisms in simple, persuasive language.

- Create distinct concepts rather than repeatedly rewriting the same angle.

- Revise copy based on feedback and advertising performance.

- Work from verified product information and genuine customer evidence without inventing testimonials, results, or claims.



**Who we’re looking for**



- Proven experience writing direct response sales copy, ideally for e-commerce brands.

- A portfolio containing long-form ads, advertorials, sales letters, or VSLs.

- Strong understanding of customer awareness, market sophistication, emotional buying motivations, and objection handling.

- Excellent written English and a natural conversational style.

- The ability to build curiosity and hold attention without padding the copy.

- Confidence researching a product and developing an angle from a brief.

- Someone who can explain the thinking behind their copy and take feedback well.



Experience writing for health and wellness brands is a plus.



Your work will be judged on the strength of its research, ideas, persuasion, and performance. Generic AI-generated copy won’t meet the standard.



**How to apply**



Please send:



1. A short introduction explaining your direct response copywriting experience.

2. Two or three relevant samples, preferably long-form
 ads or advertorials. Please make clear which pieces you personally wrote.

3. A brief explanation of the hook, angle, and sales structure behind your strongest sample.

4. Any performance results you can share, with context on what you were responsible for.

5. Your availability, preferred working arrangement, and expected rate.



Please use **“Long-Form Copywriter”** as your application subject line.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test brief.

title: Commercial Controller – BuildHawk - WFH
description:
BuildHawk is looking for an experienced Commercial Controller to manage the financial and commercial performance of residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities



•⁠  ⁠Manage and maintain project financials within Wunderbuild

•⁠  ⁠Prepare and maintain rolling 13-week cash-flow forecasts

•⁠  ⁠Manage project budgets from estimate through to completion

•⁠  ⁠Monitor budget vs actual costs

•⁠  ⁠Manage purchase orders and committed costs

•⁠  ⁠Monitor supplier and subcontractor invoices against budgets and POs

•⁠  ⁠Track progress claims, client payments and outstanding debtors

•⁠  ⁠Manage variations and their impact on project profitability

•⁠  ⁠Prepare cost-to-complete forecasts

•⁠  ⁠Forecast final project costs and gross profit

•⁠  ⁠Monitor WIP and project cash position

•⁠  ⁠Identify cost overruns, missing commitments and commercial risks early

•⁠  ⁠Ensure Wunderbuild and Xero financial information aligns

•⁠  ⁠Work closely with estimators, project managers, supervisors and accounts

•⁠  ⁠Assist with transferring approved estimates into live construction budgets

•⁠  ⁠Provide clear commercial and financial reporting to management



What We’re Looking For



•⁠  ⁠Strong construction commercial or financial management experience

•⁠  ⁠Experience with residential construction job costing

•⁠  ⁠Strong cash-flow forecasting skills

•⁠  ⁠Understanding of construction budgets, POs, commitments, variations and progress claims

•⁠  ⁠Experience with cost-to-complete and project profitability forecasting

•⁠  ⁠Strong Excel and financial modelling skills

•⁠  ⁠Xero experience

•⁠  ⁠Wunderbuild experience highly regarded

•⁠  ⁠Strong attention to detail and ability to identify financial risks early



This is not simply an accounting or bookkeeping position. We need someone who understands construction commercially and can look at a project and clearly tell us:



What have we spent?

What are we committed to?

What is still to come?

What cash do we need?

What will the project ultimately make?

title: PandaDoc Onboarding & Client Success Specialist (Part-time)
description:
ABOUT US

Pure Proposals is a PandaDoc Premier Partner. We run onboarding for new PandaDoc customers and build proposal and quoting systems for businesses in the US, Australia and Europe. We're a small, fast team and we use AI across everything we do.



THE ROLE

You'll start by leading onboarding launch calls with new PandaDoc customers. On each call you're the expert in the room. Customers come with questions about how PandaDoc works and how to set it up for their business, and your job is to guide them with confidence.



As you settle in, the role grows. You'll become part of our team helping with client success, account management, sales support and workflows across the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Run onboarding launch calls with new PandaDoc customers

2. Answer questions on how PandaDoc works and point customers to the right features for their business

3. Follow up after each call with notes, answers to anything you took away, and next steps

4. Keep records up to date in Salesforce, HubSpot, and ClickUp

5. Support existing clients with questions and check-ins (client success and account management)

6. Help with sales tasks such as replying to enquiries, booking calls and preparing follow-ups

7. Help run and improve our workflows and automations



TRAINING AND SUPPORT

We'll train you properly on PandaDoc before your first call, and keep supporting you after. A lot of this work is nuanced and you won't know every answer, especially early on. That's fine. What matters is being comfortable saying to an onboarding client "great question, leave that with me and I'll come back to you," and then doing it.



HOW WE WORK

We use Claude (AI) across the business. You'll use it to turn call transcripts into follow-up
s, notes and task lists, so the admin after each call takes minutes, not hours.



WHAT YOU NEED

1. Excellent spoken and written English

2. Proven customer service or client success experience with software customers 2+ years

3. Experience running onboarding or training calls for a software platform 2+ years

4. Confidence leading a call with a customer who expects you to know the product



HIGHLY FAVOURED

1. Prior PandaDoc experience

2. Experience with similar tools such as DocuSign, Proposify, HubSpot or Salesforce

3. Experience in account management or sales support

4. Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your work



HOURS AND PAY

20 hours per week, CEST timezone hours. Long term for the right person, with more hours as the role grows.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step won't be reviewed)

1. Start your application message with the words "PandaDoc Onboarding" so we know you read this.



2. In writing, detail your customer service experience: which companies, which software or products, how long, and what a typical day looked like - DO NOT JUST SEND GENERIC RESUME OR CV, PLEASE CUSTOMISE A TAILORED INTRODUCTION LETTER



3. Include a link to a video of NO MORE THAN 2 MINUTES (Loom, YouTube unlisted or Google Drive) answering these three questions:

   a. What software have you onboarded customers onto, and what did a typical onboarding call look like?

   b. Tell us about a time a customer asked something you didn't know. What did you say, and what happened next?

   c. Have you used PandaDoc or a similar tool? Which ones?





THE FINE PRINT



- This is an independent contractor role, not employment. Paid monthly in USD.

- The first 90 days are a trial period, with a review at the end.

- You'll need your own computer, a stable internet connection and a backup for power or internet outages. (VERY GOOD internet connection is critical, since you'll be on video calls with clients)

- Calls are mostly in CEST timezone, so you'll need to be available around those hours. 



Thank you, we are looking forward to reviewing your profile!

title: Senior Bookkeeper – Multiplatform E-Commerce Accounting Specialist
description:
About the Company

The company delivers high-performance Amazon PPC management, earning client trust through precision, insight, and proven results. Driven by steady organic growth and supported by a small team of experts, this role presents a unique opportunity to advance alongside a business anchored in true quality rather than hype.



About the role

We are seeking a Senior Bookkeeper with extensive, hands-on E-commerce accounting expertise, rather than a general bookkeeper with only a basic understanding of online retail. You must thoroughly comprehend the intricate complexities of multi-platform selling, including settlement timing, marketplace fee structures, split inventory pools, returns, and precise cross-channel COGS tracking. The ideal candidate works independently, takes full ownership of their output, and possesses the ability to train an operational team to effectively interpret financial data.

Applicants who lack direct experience in E-commerce inventory bookkeeping, COGS recognition, inventory asset management, and multi-platform reconciliation will not be considered. Standard bookkeeping experience alone does not fulfill the requirements for this role.



What you'll own

E-commerce & Amazon Accounting Specialist

Multi E-Commerce Platform accounting reconciliation: sales, refunds, FBA/referral/storage fees, sponsored ads, and reimbursements are correctly categorised and posted.

Multi-platform revenue reconciliation: Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Chewy and more, each with its own payout timing, fees, and reporting format reconciled into one accurate GL.

Marketplace tax handling: marketplace facilitator tax flows correctly without inflating revenue.

Ad spend allocation: Amazon PPC and off-platform spend treated correctly as operating expenses, reconciled against actual campaign data.



Inventory bookkeeping & COGS

Inventory as a balance sheet asset: purchase orders posted to inventory, not expensed; landed costs (freight, duties, prep) correctly capitalised.

COGS recognition: accurate cost matched to units sold using FIFO or weighted average as appropriate; no blunt average cost assumptions masking margin.

Multi-location inventory:  FBA fulfilment centres, 3PL warehouses, and owned stock are each correctly reflected on the balance sheets.

Inventory reconciliation: regular reconciliation of system counts against accounting records; variances from shrinkage, damage, returns, and Amazon discrepancies are properly adjusted.

Returns & kitting: correct treatment of resellable vs destroyed returns; component-level COGS allocation for bundled and kitted SKUs.



Agency & internal accounting

Full-cycle bookkeeping: chart of accounts, journal entries, bank feeds, reconciliations, and month-end close.

AP/AR, contractor payments, client invoicing, retainer tracking, and project cost allocation

Clean, audit-ready books at all times; not catch-up dependent





Manager training

Build practical SOPs and train hands-on managers in daily financial workflows, platform navigation, and report interpretation; building real confidence, not dependency

Platform requirements:

Accounting

Xero

QuickBooks Online

QuickBooks Desktop

E-commerce

Amazon Seller Central

Walmart

Chewy

And More





Experience required:

5+ years of bookkeeping, with at least 4 years in e-commerce or Amazon seller accounts.

Proven inventory asset accounting;  landed costs, multi-location tracking, FIFO/WAC implementation.

Multi-platform settlement reconciliation into a single, accurate general ledger

Agency or multi-client bookkeeping experience, including internal accounting structures

Certified or highly proficient in Xero, QuickBooks Online, and QuickBooks Desktop

Track record of training non-finance staff in bookkeeping processes

title: Client Delivery Manager — YouTube & Video Production (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
I’m George, a YouTube creator and business owner. We produce educational videos and software tutorials for brands, with a team handling scripting, editing, and design.



I’m looking for someone who can take full ownership of client delivery once I close a deal.



The goal is simple: you give me an approved script, I record the video and upload the footage, and you manage everything needed to deliver excellent work to a happy client.



You’ll be the main point of contact for clients and the person keeping our production team organized, accountable, and moving forward.



What you’ll own



Client onboarding: Collect briefs, brand assets, product access, deadlines, and everything the team needs.

Topic alignment: Coordinate ideas with the team and get client approval on topics and angles.

Scripting: Brief writers, review scripts for clarity and accuracy, manage feedback, and secure approval before recording.

Recording preparation: Give me a complete recording package, including the approved script, demo access, and any important instructions.

Production management: Coordinate writers, editors, and designers. Set realistic deadlines, follow up, and resolve blockers early.

Quality control: Review videos against the brief and approved script. Catch incorrect information, missing sections, weak edits, and wrong CTAs before the client sees them.

Client communication: Send clear updates, manage expectations, collect feedback, and keep clients informed.

Revisions: Turn feedback into clear instructions, check that changes are completed, and flag requests outside the agreed scope.

Delivery and publishing: Make sure final videos, thumbnails, descriptions, and other agreed assets are ready and delivered or published correctly.

Invoice follow-up: Track payment status, send reminders, and flag overdue payments.

Process improvement: Keep our project board accurate and improve checklists and workflows as you learn the business.



You’ll work with our existing production team. You need to be able to brief writers and editors and judge their work; personally writing and editing every video is not required.



Who we’re looking for



You have experience managing client projects at a video production company, creative agency, content business, or similar environment.



You can confidently communicate with clients in English, coordinate several projects at once, and give clear feedback to creative team members.



Most importantly, you follow through. When something is delayed, unclear, or below standard, you take action and stay with it until it is resolved.



You should be comfortable:



* Managing deadlines, dependencies, and competing priorities.

* Reviewing scripts and videos with close attention to detail.

* Having respectful but firm conversations about deadlines and quality.

* Making decisions independently within agreed boundaries.

* Bringing a proposed solution when you need help.

* Using project management tools, Google Drive, and AI tools responsibly.

* Learning software products well enough to spot mistakes in tutorials.



Experience with YouTube tutorials, software brands, and remote creative teams is a strong advantage.



What success looks like



* Scripts are approved and ready before recording.

* Every active project has a clear owner, next action, and deadline.

* Problems are raised early, with a plan to resolve them.

* Clients receive updates without having to chase us.

* Work is checked properly before it reaches the client.

* Revisions and invoice follow-ups don’t get forgotten.

* I can focus on recording while you keep delivery moving.



Working arrangement



This is a full-time role intended to become a long-term working relationship.



We need reliable availability during agreed working hours and enough capacity for this to be your primary professional commitment. Please be transparent about any other work you plan to continue.



You’ll have direct access to me, an existing production team, and clear responsibility for the delivery process. We’ll agree on your decision-making authority and when issues should be escalated.



How to apply



Please use the subject line: **Client Delivery Manager — [Your Name]**



Include:



1. A short introduction explaining why your experience fits this role.

2. An example of a video or creative project you managed. Explain what you personally owned and how many projects you handled at once.

3. A specific example of a project that went off track. What did you do, and what happened?

4. A redacted example of a project board, production brief, or client update you created. Please remove confidential information.

5. Your expected monthly salary, earliest start date, available working hours and timezone, and any ongoing work commitments.

6. Your answer to this scenario:



A video is due to the client tomorrow. The editor hasn’t delivered the draft, the client has just requested a change to the approved script, and George is unavailable for the next six hours. What would you do first, and what would you communicate to each person?**



Keep your application concise and specific. Real examples will help us understand how you work.



Our hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment based on realistic client and production situations. This takes approximately 60–75 minutes.



We’ll then have a video call to discuss your decisions. The selected finalist will complete a paid one-week trial, with the scope, schedule, and compensation agreed in advance.



We’re looking for someone who wants to take responsibility, build a strong working relationship with the team, and help us deliver work we’re proud of.

title: AI UGC Video Editor – Korean Skincare Brand (DTC / Meta Ads)
description:
Mon–Fri | $650–$850/month + performance bonuses



ABOUT US



Fast-growing Korean skincare brand selling to US customers

Our ads run on Meta:
 and Instagram feeds, Reels and Stories

We need a HIGH VOLUME of new ads every week



THE JOB



We give you a script plus a reference video or competitor ad. You turn it into an AI video ad that's ready to test.

Output: 1–3 videos per day, 2–3 minutes each

Make fast variations of winning ads (same ad, 5 new hooks) if it's assigned

Switch between formats: UGC talking heads, AI Pixar-style animation, AI musical ads



THIS IS NOT A "CINEMATIC" JOB



It's marketing-first editing: every cut, caption and transition has to stop the scroll and drive the click

If it looks like a brand commercial, people scroll past it

We want speed, quality and ads that sell, not slow "pretty" videos



OUR STYLE



Looks like a real person filmed it on their phone

Casual talking head, straight to camera

Handheld feel and natural lighting

Hard cuts every 2–4 seconds, with no fancy transitions or color grades

Big, readable captions burned in

B-roll that shows the product in action

The first 3 seconds must stop the scroll

AI avatars and voiceovers must feel human, not like a news anchor. This is the core skill.



TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW



Higgsfield for b-roll and Pixar-style scenes and avatars

HeyGen for AI avatars and talking heads

ElevenLabs for voiceovers

Suno for AI music in musical ads

ChatGPT / Claude for prompting

CapCut and/or Premiere Pro

Notion and Google Drive (basic use)



REQUIREMENTS



1+ year of experience editing short-form ads (UGC, direct response or Meta ads preferred)

Portfolio required

Fluent English

Can produce high volume without dropping quality

Understands hooks, pacing, captions, b-roll and creative testing

Organized, follows instructions and meets deadlines

Available Monday to Friday (no weekends)



WHAT YOU GET



$650–$850/month, based on experience and speed

Bonuses on ads that win and scale

Long-term role with room to grow



NOT FOR YOU IF



You prefer a slow pace or one project a week

You care more about how a video looks than how it sells



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



Start your application TITLE with the letter "X". It goes in the title, not the message. Applications without the X will not be reviewed.

Send your portfolio with A GOOGLE DRIVE LINK, not canva's or websites. Put UGC, direct-response, Meta ads, Pixar-style AI or AI musical ads first.

In 1–2 lines, tell us how many finished ads you can realistically deliver per day.



NEXT STEPS



If you're eligible of us, we'll have a short video call.

Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind emails that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

title: UGC & Tribe Creator Manager
description:
**Brand:** Movira  

**Role:** UGC & Creator Tribe Manager  

**Type:** Remote



Movira is a growing DTC wellness brand, and we’re looking for a highly organized, proactive **UGC & Creator Tribe Manager** to take hands-on ownership of our creator community.



This is not a passive coordination role. We’re looking for someone who is **very active on TikTok and Instagram**, understands creator culture, knows how to spot people who naturally fit a brand, and genuinely enjoys building relationships with creators.



You’ll receive clear strategic guidance and have a **weekly meeting with the founder**, but you’ll be responsible for the day-to-day execution and management of the UGC pipeline.



### What you'll be doing



- Actively scout potential UGC creators on **TikTok and Instagram**

- Identify creators who naturally match our target customers and brand aesthetic

- Reach out to creators and manage communication from first contact through content delivery

- Build and maintain our **UGC creator tribe**

- Brief creators using guidelines and creative direction provided by us

- Coordinate product seeding and creator collaborations

- Follow up consistently to make sure content is delivered on time

- Keep track of creator status, content, deadlines, usage rights and deliverables

- Review incoming UGC and make sure it follows the brief

- Communicate feedback and request revisions when necessary

- Maintain strong relationships with our best-performing creators and encourage repeat collaborations

- Continuously look for new creator opportunities and emerging TikTok/Instagram trends

- Keep the founder updated on progress, bottlenecks and opportunities



We're looking for someone who



- Is **very active on TikTok and Instagram** and understands how content on these platforms actually works

- Has experience working with UGC creators, influencers or creator communities

- Is an excellent communicator and feels comfortable messaging creators every day

- Is proactive — you don't wait to be told to follow up

- Is highly organized and can manage many creator conversations at the same time

- Has a good eye for identifying creators who feel authentic rather than overly polished or "ad-like"

- Understands UGC and direct-response/DTC content

- Can work independently once the direction and priorities are clear

- Is comfortable giving creators feedback in a friendly but clear way

- Speaks and writes excellent English



What success looks like



We don't want someone who simply maintains a spreadsheet of creators.



We want someone who **owns the creator pipeline**, consistently finding new talent, starting conversations, getting products into creators' hands, making sure content gets delivered, maintaining relationships, and helping us build a reliable network of creators we can work with repeatedly.



You'll have guidance, briefs and strategic direction from us, including a **weekly session with the founder**, but we're specifically looking for someone who can take that direction and run with it during the week.



To apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience with UGC/influencer management.

2. Links to any brands or creator programs you've previously worked with.

3. Your personal TikTok/Instagram or examples showing that you're genuinely familiar with these platforms.

4. Tell us how you would find **20 potential UGC creators for a women's wellness brand in the US**.

5. Your availability and expected monthly compensation.



**Bonus:** Send us 3 TikTok or Instagram creators you think could be a good fit for Movira and briefly explain why you chose them.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a genuine part of the brand and help us build a strong creator community, not simply complete assigned tasks.

s? Have a creative eye, know your way around Klaviyo and enjoy working independently? I’d love to hear from you!



I’m an independent
 marketer working with several e-commerce brands. I’m looking for a freelance designer to help bring their
s to life through creative design and careful implementation in Klaviyo.



There are currently 2–3 clients with approximately 30
s per month in total, with room to grow together.

What you’ll do

You’ll independently design
s in Figma and implement them in Klaviyo, working on both campaigns and automated flows.

I appreciate someone who can move quickly, switch between brands and manage their own planning.



Creativity & AI

Working with AI is encouraged! I’m happy for you to use tools that help you create great work efficiently.



The final design should feel original and tailored to the brand. I’m looking for more than a recognisable standard Claude template: think creative overlays, unique layouts, layered visuals and thoughtful details where they suit the brand.



Your own creativity and design judgment should shine through in every
.



What you bring

You have at least 3 years of relevant experience designing e-commerce
s and strong skills in both Figma and Klaviyo.



You’re creative, independent and attentive to detail. You can develop a design without needing instructions for every element, while knowing when to ask questions.



Your portfolio contains at least 10
 designs that show your design skills and ability to work with different brands.



How we’ll work together

Communication takes place via WhatsApp, with a response expected within 4 hours during agreed working hours.



Feedback should be implemented within one working day.



You communicate clearly about your availability, planning and delivery dates. You let me know what you need upfront, set realistic expectations and flag any delays early.



Proactive updates, quick coordination and open communication are important to me. We’ll agree on working hours together, taking your time zone into account.



Workload & budget

The current workload is approximately 30
s per month across all clients combined.



Standard setup package: $200 fixed fee



Includes 14
s and one pop-up, with design and implementation in Klaviyo.



First 30 individual
s per month: $17 per



Includes design and implementation in Klaviyo.



Each additional
 beyond 30: $15 per



Includes design and implementation in Klaviyo. This lower rate applies to the additional
s.



Monthly volume is calculated across all clients combined. Standard setup packages are priced separately and do not count towards the monthly
 tier.



These rates include processing feedback on the agreed brief and checking desktop and mobile layouts before delivery. My previous designer handled both design and Klaviyo implementation within these rates, and I’m looking for the same scope.



Interested? I’d love to see your work!

Please send a short introduction, your portfolio with at least 10
 designs, your time zone, working hours and availability. Include your usual turnaround time and confirm that the pricing and scope work for you.



Applications without a portfolio containing at least 10
 designs will not be considered or receive a response.



If you love creative
 design and are looking for a long-term collaboration with clear communication, I’d love to connect!

title: Part-Time Influencer Research Agent
description:
We are looking for an experienced Influencer Research Agent to find high-quality creators for The DIY Projct across Instagram and TikTok.



The role involves researching creators, analysing their content and performance, identifying the right product fit, and accurately adding suitable creators to our Influencer Research Sheet.



We are focused on quality over quantity. The goal is not simply to find as many creators as possible, but to identify creators who genuinely fit our brand and have the potential to create strong content and generate organic interest and sales.



Responsibilities



* Research creators primarily on Instagram and TikTok using our official accounts.

* Find creators within DIY, arts & crafts, home décor, painting, engraving, handmade products, family DIY, UGC, and related niches.

* Analyse creator profiles based on content quality, views, engagement, audience interaction, posting consistency, niche relevance, and overall collaboration potential.

* Identify which of our products would be the best fit for each creator.

* Follow our detailed Influencer Research SOP and creator scoring system.

* Correctly classify creators as Priority, Secondary Priority, Manual Review, or Reject based on our criteria.

* Add all creator information accurately to our Google Sheet.

* Write clear comments and reasoning where required.

* Check for duplicate or previously researched creators before adding new accounts.

* Follow feedback, instructions, and updates to the SOP consistently.

* Maintain a high standard of research quality and accuracy.



What we provide:

* A detailed Influencer Research SOP.

* A structured Google Sheet and creator scoring system.

* Access to our official Instagram and TikTok accounts for research.

* Clear criteria for evaluating and categorising creators.

* Product information and guidance on which creators are suitable for each product.

* Ongoing feedback and direction from our team.



Requirements

* Previous influencer research experience is mandatory. Applications without relevant experience will not be considered.

* Experience researching creators for a brand, agency, or influencer marketing campaign.

* Good understanding of Instagram and TikTok.

* Ability to evaluate creators beyond follower count, including views, engagement, audience quality, content quality, niche relevance, and brand fit.

* Good spoken and written English.

* Ability to understand and follow a detailed SOP accurately.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Good research and analytical skills.

* Comfortable working extensively with Google Sheets.

* Ability to work independently and consistently follow scoring criteria.

* Ability to make objective decisions about creator quality rather than simply adding accounts to increase numbers.

* Good understanding of creative content and whether a creator could realistically produce strong content around our products.



Employment Details



* Position: Part-time

* Work Type: Remote

* Payment: Monthly or bi-weekly

* Workload: Varies based on weekly research requirements



Your performance will be evaluated based on the quality of creators found, approval rate, accuracy of classifications, quality of research, data accuracy, and ability to consistently follow the SOP.



We are not looking for someone who can simply find the highest number of creators. We want someone who can consistently find good creators that are genuinely worth collaborating with.



If you have previous influencer research experience, strong attention to detail, good English communication skills, and are comfortable following a structured research process, we would love to hear from you.



When applying, please include:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Details of your previous influencer research experience.

* Which platforms you have researched creators on.

* Examples of brands, agencies, or projects you have worked with, if applicable.

* Approximately how many creators you have researched in previous roles.

* Your experience using Google Sheets.

* Your current availability for part-time work.



Please begin your application with the words “Creativity Simplified” so we know you have read the complete job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be given a small paid influencer research test using our SOP and scoring system before being offered the position.

title: Etsy Growth & Store Manager – Digital Products
description:
I am looking for an experienced, commercially minded Etsy Growth & Store Manager to take ownership of an existing digital-products store.



This is not a basic VA, data-entry or listing-upload role.



The store sells digital spreadsheet products, primarily Excel and Google Sheets templates. It currently has an established catalogue but is significantly underperforming, generating only around US$30 per month in normal sales.



I believe the store has considerably more potential and am looking for someone who can bring a fresh approach, identify what is holding it back and turn it into a commercially successful store.



Initial 4-month growth sprint



The initial engagement will be a four-month growth sprint, working up to 20 hours per week.



If we achieve strong results, my intention is for this to develop into a long-term Store Manager position, with increased responsibility, additional resources and the opportunity for compensation to grow with the store.



I care much more about results than simply hours worked.



What you will do

You will take ownership of the store's growth, including:

- Analyse the existing store, listings and performance

- Identify why products are or are not selling

- Etsy SEO and keyword research

- Competitor and market research

- Identify new product opportunities

- Improve product positioning, pricing and bundles

- Improve thumbnails, titles, descriptions and tags

- Analyse traffic and conversion

- Test ideas and measure results

- Identify products that should be improved, expanded or discontinued

- Help develop new digital-product concepts

- Make basic to intermediate improvements to Excel and Google Sheets products when required

- Provide a simple weekly update covering results, work completed, findings and next priorities



I am not looking for someone who waits for a daily task list.



I want someone who can look at the store, understand what the numbers are saying, identify opportunities and tell me what we should do next.



The person I am looking for

You should have:

- Proven experience growing Etsy stores

- Strong understanding of Etsy SEO, conversion and product research

- Experience with digital products

- Strong commercial judgement

- Confidence analysing store performance and making recommendations

- Good working knowledge of Excel and/or Google Sheets

- Ability to make changes to spreadsheet products where required

- Strong written English

- Reliable communication

- A proactive, ownership-focused approach



Your ability to grow an Etsy store is more important than being an advanced spreadsheet developer.



As the store grows, I intend to add specialist product-development support so that the Store Manager can focus increasingly on growth and commercial performance.



Compensation

US$8–10/hour depending on experience

Up to 20 hours per week initially

Performance bonuses in addition to hourly pay

The role includes one-off bonuses for reaching new monthly sales milestones:

- US$250 sales = US$25 bonus

- US$500 = US$50

- US$1,000 = US$100

- US$2,000 = US$200

- US$3,000 = US$300

- US$5,000 = US$500

- US$10,000 = US$1,000



The incentive structure will continue at higher revenue levels as the store grows.



If multiple new milestones are reached in the same month, all applicable milestone bonuses will be paid.



For example, if sales move from US$500/month to US$2,000/month, the US$1,000 and US$2,000 bonuses would both be paid.



There is significant upside for someone who can genuinely scale the business.



To apply

Please answer the following questions in your application:

1. Tell me about an Etsy store you have personally helped grow.

What were sales like before you became involved, what did they grow to, how long did it take, and what did you personally change?

2. If you inherited an Etsy digital-products store currently generating around US$30–40/month, what would you do in your first 30 days?

3. How do you determine whether an Etsy listing has a traffic problem, SEO problem, conversion problem or product problem?

4. Tell me about a digital product you have helped successfully launch or improve.

5. What experience do you have with Excel and Google Sheets?

You do not need to be an advanced spreadsheet developer, but you should be comfortable modifying and improving spreadsheet products.



Please provide examples or evidence of previous results wherever possible.



Generic applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Executive Assistant + Business Development for UK Founder
description:
I run three UK businesses: a premium garden design-and-build company, a reformer Pilates studio and a business coaching brand. I spend my days working in them, and I need someone working on them: a sharp assistant who takes development projects off my list, gets them done properly and comes back to me for feedback.



THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF

You need to be told how to do every task. You're after inbox or diary work. You haven't done business development before. You wait to be chased.



WHO WE ARE

The main business designs and builds gardens for homeowners across Leicestershire and the surrounding counties. There's also a reformer Pilates studio, and my personal brand, where I share what I've learned about growing a business. This role sits completely outside the day-to-day running of all three. You won't be dealing with clients, staff or site teams.



THE ROLE

Every day I add tasks to a written list. You pick them up, work out the best way to do them and get them done, then send me the finished work for feedback. It's 10 to 15 hours a week, working on the businesses rather than in them. You report to me, but you won't need me beside you to get going.



WHAT YOUR WEEK LOOKS LIKE

Most of the list is business development. One day it might be pulling our numbers together so I can see where enquiries come from and what they're worth. The next it might be putting a new strategy into practice, building a process, researching a market or turning a rough idea into a plan with the steps and costs laid out. You'll use AI tools heavily to do this faster and better, and you'll know when to check their work.



You'll also schedule our social media. Someone else already makes the videos, around ten a week across the three businesses. You'll plan when and where each one goes out, write or check the captions, load them into the scheduler and keep the posting calendar up to date, then send me the plan for sign-off.

Tasks come in writing, so you can work the hours that suit you. We'll talk over messages, and I'll give feedback as work lands.



MUST-HAVES

You'll answer each of these Yes or No, so read them properly.

1. At least three years in business development, or as an executive assistant or virtual assistant working on growth projects for a business owner.

2. Excellent written English, with the OnlineJobs.ph English test showing C1 or C2 on your profile. It's free and takes 30 minutes if you haven't done it yet.

3. Real business development experience: you've pulled together business numbers, built processes or put new strategies into action, and you can show examples.

4. Confident using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to get real work done, from research and analysis to drafting and automation.

5. Happy working on your own from a written task list, and asking for feedback rather than instructions.

6. Your own computer and stable internet, with a backup for power and internet.

7. Able to commit 10 to 15 hours a week, long-term.



NICE TO HAVE

Previous experience of 
 is a strong preference and will put you near the top of the pile. Scheduling social media in Meta Business Suite or a similar tool, strong spreadsheet skills and experience with UK or small businesses all help.



HOURS AND PAY

$7 to $10 USD an hour depending on experience, for 10 to 15 hours a week, worked when it suits you across the weekdays. Long-term and work from home, with room for more hours later if it works well for both of us.



HOW TO APPLY

Use 15 Apply Points.

Start your application with the words COPPER BEECH on the first line. Applications without it are deleted unread.

Under that, copy the seven must-haves and answer each one Yes or No.

Then send us:

Five sentences at most on a business development project you delivered: the goal, what you did and the result, with numbers if you have them. No company names needed.

Which AI tools you use every week, and one thing you've used them for that saved real time.

If you've used 
, for how long and what for. If not, which project management tool you've used instead.

A link to a 60 to 90 second voice recording telling us about a task you took from a one-line brief to finished without being chased. Vocaroo, Loom or Google Drive, open to anyone with the link.

Your expected hourly rate in USD.

What other work you do at the moment, and how many hours it takes.

Your earliest start date.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial task: about two hours, based on the kind of work on the list and is due within 72 hours of being given. The best go through to a video call with me, and we're hiring within two weeks of this post going live.

Thanks for reading to the end. Most people don't.

Miles

title: Google Ads Specialist (Scaling + Claude Code) - Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
We are a digital services company that helps small and medium businesses manage and improve their online presence. We are

hiring a Google Ads Specialist to run and scale our paid search campaigns. This is a full-time, long-term, work-from-home

role.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

A large part of the day-to-day work is executed through Claude Code, an AI command-line tool that we use to build, audit,

adjust, and report on our Google Ads campaigns. You do not need to be a programmer. You do need to be comfortable working

inside a command-line tool, following written prompts and playbooks, reading what the tool outputs, and checking its work

against the live Google Ads account. We will give you the playbooks. Your job is to run them correctly, understand what

they are doing, and apply real Google Ads judgment on top of them. If the idea of running your campaign work through an AI

tool instead of only clicking around the Google Ads dashboard excites you rather than worries you, you are the person we

want.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build, manage, and optimize Google Search campaigns end to end

- Run daily and weekly campaign operations through Claude Code following our playbooks

- Manage keywords, negatives, bids, budgets, and ad copy

- Read performance data, spot what is working and what is wasting money, and act on it

- Scale campaigns up in a controlled, structured way as performance proves out, not just launch and forget

- Keep clean records of every change and why it was made

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven, hands-on Google Ads experience. Not a course you took. Real accounts you have run.

- Direct experience SCALING campaigns, not only running small ones. You have taken a campaign from a small budget to a

much larger monthly spend while keeping results healthy.

- Strong understanding of Search campaigns: match types, negative keywords, Quality Score, conversion tracking, bidding

strategies, and when to use each.

- Comfortable with tools, dashboards, and following technical instructions precisely. Willingness to work through Claude

Code is a hard requirement.

- Excellent written English and clear reporting.

- Reliable, detail-obsessed, and honest about what the numbers actually say.

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS A TEST)

Applications that skip any of these steps will be ignored. We are checking whether you read instructions, because this job

is about following instructions precisely.

1. Start your message with this exact word on the very first line: SCALE-CODE

2. Then answer these three questions in order:

a) Name the companies or accounts where you have run Google Ads, and for each one, roughly what monthly ad spend you

managed and what results you drove.

b) Describe ONE specific campaign you scaled. Tell us the starting budget, the budget you scaled it to, and what

happened to cost per lead or cost per sale as you scaled. Real numbers.

c) Have you ever worked inside a command-line tool or an AI tool like Claude Code, ChatGPT with tools, or similar?

Describe it honestly. If you have not, tell us why you are confident you can learn it fast.

3. Attach or link proof: a screenshot from a Google Ads account you have managed, or a short Loom video walking through

one of your accounts. Blur the client name if you need to.

4. Tell us your available full-time hours and how soon you can start.

We reply to strong applications quickly. Weak or copy-paste applications get no reply. Show us you are the real thing.
