This role is responsible for building and maintaining secure, high-performance backend systems using Java and Spring Boot, while also contributing to frontend development to support end-to-end feature delivery.

Working closely with the Head of Engineering, product stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will own features from architecture through deployment, with particular emphasis on backend system design, database architecture, and multi-tenant data handling. This role also requires clear, confident communication, as the candidate will regularly collaborate with international team members and may be required to speak directly with clients and customers.



Responsibilities

Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable REST APIs and backend services using Java and Spring Boot.

Frontend Contribution: Build and maintain frontend features and interfaces using React (or an equivalent modern framework), ensuring smooth integration with backend services.

Database Architecture: Design, maintain, and optimise PostgreSQL databases, including relational data models and multi-tenant data segregation strategies (e.g., application-level tenancy vs. row-level security).

Systems Integration: Build and maintain integrations with third-party services and internal APIs to support business workflows.

Application Security: Apply secure software development practices, including authentication, authorization, and data segregation across tenants/clients.

Code Quality: Produce clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while participating in peer reviews and development best practices.

Client & Team Communication: Communicate clearly and confidently with engineering leadership, distributed teams, and clients as required, including verbal communication in English.

Project Collaboration: Work within an Agile environment, providing regular updates on development progress, technical decisions, and challenges.



Requirements

Minimum 4 years of proven commercial experience developing backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

Strong, current, hands-on experience with the most recent stable versions of Spring Boot (not solely early-career or outdated exposure).

Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.

Solid PostgreSQL database design and optimisation skills, including a clear understanding of multi-tenant data architecture (application-level tenancy vs. PostgreSQL row-level security).

Working experience with a modern frontend framework (React strongly preferred), with demonstrated project experience, not solely listed familiarity.

Experience deploying containerised applications using Docker.

Good understanding of application security principles and secure development practices.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with confidence discussing technical concepts with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including clients.

Experience using AI-assisted software development tools is highly regarded.



Software Proficiency

Programming Languages – Java

Frameworks – Spring Boot

Frontend – React (or equivalent modern framework)

Containerisation – Docker

Database Technologies – PostgreSQL

API Technologies – REST APIs

AI Development Tools – GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent



Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: WordPress Business Directory Update with Local SEO (Project Based)
description:
About Us

We are the Busselton Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BCCI), a not-for-profit business organisation representing businesses across Busselton, Vasse, Dunsborough and Yallingup in the South West of Western Australia. Our website includes a business directory of our members, and we want every listing to be complete, accurate and easy to search.

The Project

We need an experienced VA to update approximately 180 business listings in our WordPress directory. The site is built with WordPress and Elementor. This is a one-off project with a clear finish line: every listing updated, consistent and optimised for local search.

What You Will Do

• Review and update each member listing using the business’s own website and Google Business Profile where available.

• Write or improve a clear, original business description for each listing (roughly 100  words), naturally including what the business does and where it operates, e.g. "electrician in Busselton".

• Keep the business name, address and phone number exactly consistent with the business’s other online listings.

• Assign the correct categories and tags so users can filter and browse the directory properly.

• Write an SEO title and meta description for each listing.

• Upload or replace logos and images, compress them for speed, and add descriptive alt text.

• Add website, social media and opening hours details where provided.

• Check that each listing displays correctly on desktop and mobile.

• Keep a simple tracking spreadsheet showing each listing, its status and any missing information we need to chase.

Must Have

• Proven experience editing WordPress sites, including Elementor.

• Experience with WordPress directory plugin Listeo.

• Solid understanding of on-page and local SEO: titles, meta descriptions, keywords, alt text and consistent business details.

• Excellent written English. Our audience is Australian, so Australian spelling is needed (e.g. "organisation", "optimise").

• Strong attention to detail and consistency across a large number of entries.

• Reliable internet and availability.



How We Will Work

• You will get your own WordPress login with the access level needed for this work. Please do not share logins or install plugins or themes without written approval.

• We will give you a style guide and 3 sample listings to complete first. Once approved, you will complete the rest.

• Progress check-ins every few days via
.

• All content you write becomes the property of BCCI. No AI-generated text may be published without being checked and edited for accuracy.

How to Apply

To show you have read this post, start your application with the words "Busselton Directory".

1. Tell us about a WordPress directory or listings project you have completed, with a link if possible.

2. Name the directory plugins and SEO plugins you have used.

3. Write a sample 100-word listing description for a fictional café in Dunsborough, including a meta title (under 60 characters) and meta description (under 160 characters).

4. Give your fixed price or hourly rate for approximately 180 listings, and your estimated timeframe.

Applications without the sample will not be considered.

title: Fleet Repair Admin
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, equipment moving, and operations supported from pickup to delivery. If you’re someone who enjoys staying engaged, solving live challenges, and helping keep trucks and trailers operational, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You will support the operational backbone of the company by helping monitor fleet health, repair progress, preventive maintenance, internal team communication, and compliance tracking. This role is built for someone who can stay organized, follow up consistently, and help reduce downtime by making sure repair and maintenance issues are tracked, communicated, and completed properly.



If you thrive behind the scenes keeping equipment moving, coordinating updates, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitoring truck and trailer maintenance, repair status, and service progress

• Tracking real time repair updates and following up with mechanics, dispatch, and internal teams

• Coordinating with mechanics, dispatch, and internal teams to prioritize urgent repairs

• Supporting preventive maintenance planning to help reduce breakdowns and downtime

• Updating maintenance trackers, dashboards, TMS, and internal systems with accurate repair notes and status updates

• Reviewing and tracking repair approvals, invoices, estimates, and billing updates

• Helping ensure DOT and FMCSA maintenance related compliance items are properly monitored

• Identifying repair delays, recurring equipment issues, and downtime risks early

• Escalating urgent maintenance concerns to the appropriate team members

• Maintaining clean documentation for repairs, maintenance history, internal team communication, and follow ups

• Following instructions consistently and executing with precision

• Staying team oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego



What Success Looks Like

• Fleet maintenance and repair trackers are consistently accurate and up to date

• Repair progress is monitored closely from start to completion

• Urgent equipment issues are escalated quickly and clearly

• Downtime risks are identified early and communicated properly

• Preventive maintenance items are followed up on before they become larger issues

• Mechanic, dispatch, and operations updates are organized and documented

• Repair approvals, invoices, and billing items are tracked cleanly

• Equipment status updates are communicated clearly, both verbally and in writing

• Shift handoffs are complete, accurate, and well documented



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in fleet maintenance, trucking operations, logistics, dispatch support, or administrative fleet operations

• Has basic mechanical knowledge or familiarity with trucks, trailers, repairs, and maintenance processes

• Understands the importance of equipment uptime, preventive maintenance, and fast repair follow up

• Highly organized and comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, TMS, and maintenance tracking tools

• Able to monitor multiple repairs, trucks, trailers, and mechanics updates without losing accuracy

• Communicates clearly and professionally with mechanics, drivers, dispatch, and internal teams

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live logistics environment

• Familiar with DOT and FMCSA maintenance compliance requirements is a plus

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean processes

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego

• Minimum of 50 words per minute



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage and asset based logistics operation

• Performance based advancement



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Remote Role | Direct Hire to US Company

• Schedule: Dayshift 9 AM - 7 PM & Night shift Central Time (To be finalized during hiring)

• Zoom presence required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

• Reliable internet connection and home office setup required for real time communication



This role is built for someone who genuinely enjoys keeping fleet operations organized, following repair progress, coordinating with mechanics, internal teams, and dispatch making sure trucks and trailers stay operational. If you like staying proactive, spotting risks before they become bigger problems, and helping reduce downtime behind the scenes, you’ll fit right in.

title: Bookkeeper & Payroll Specialist (NDIS)
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, hands-on Xero payroll experience and proven award interpretation (SCHADS Award experience highly regarded) will be prioritised for this role.



A registered NDIS provider operating across multiple entities needs a full-time Bookkeeper & Payroll Specialist to own high-volume daily bookkeeping and fortnightly payroll under the direction of the company's main accountant. The key challenge is accuracy and consistency: payroll must be error-free, bank reconciliations must be kept current across nine accounts despite receipts and remittances coming from many different people, and every rental property and utility bill must receive its correct treatment.



Success looks like payroll reaching final review error-free, bank reconciliations staying close to current, no repeated mistakes, and over time, a VA who improves the checklists and systems rather than working around them.



What You'll Own



Payroll



Process fortnightly payroll in Xero for 60 to 100 employees across multiple entities

Cross-check timesheets through the approval chain (care coordinator approval, then manager approval) before they flow into Xero

Process manual timesheets submitted by
 and through SharePoint

Apply correct pay, penalty and weekend rates under the SCHADS Award and internal rules, working through the documented payroll checklist in full every pay run

Prepare for and attend the final payslip check during payroll weeks

Manage the payroll mailbox, responding to staff, HR and manager queries about pay and timesheets



Bank Reconciliations



Reconcile all nine Xero bank accounts daily, often more than 15 transactions per account per day

For spend transactions: obtain the correct receipt, enter it as a bill with the correct GL code and GST treatment, attach the receipt, then reconcile

For money received: reconcile against the remittance advice, chasing a remittance where one hasn't been provided

Track outstanding receipts and remittances, following up until they are cleared



Accounts Payable & Receivable



Manage bills and invoicing, and follow up late payments

Enter rental invoices for the properties the business rents, applying the correct treatment for each (staff-paid, business-invoiced, or payroll-deducted)

Apply the same treatment logic to utility bills

Liaise daily with reception, who send through invoices for reconciliation



Records & Data



Maintain asset logs

Perform data entry, maintain the internal database, and manage digital files



Inbox Management



Act as the main person responsible for four to five main inboxes, up to six to seven across the entities

Make sure every
 is actioned and routed to the right inbox, following the existing process



Ad Hoc Team Support



Once finance tasks are complete, provide administrative support to HR and the care coordinators



Process Improvement



Identify gaps or better ways of working in finance processes and raise them

Update checklists as new issues are found



What We're Looking For



Experience



Minimum 2 years in bookkeeping and finance roles

Proven payroll processing experience for a workforce with variable hours, penalty rates and award interpretation

Experience with Australian companies is required

Experience with the SCHADS Award, NDIS or aged care is a strong bonus

Experience working across multiple entities



Communication Skills



Polite, patient and understanding with every department, including HR, managers, care coordinators and reception

Clear written English for the payroll and accounts mailboxes

Able to chase receipts and remittances persistently without damaging relationships



Technical Proficiency



Xero is mandatory: high proficiency in payroll, bank reconciliation, bills, sales invoices, GL coding and GST treatment

Strong spreadsheet skills in Excel

Comfortable in Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace and Microsoft Office

CareMaster experience is a bonus and trainable



Organisational Skills



Tracks open items across nine bank accounts without losing anything, even when receipts take days to arrive

Holds and applies different treatments across two dozen properties and their utility bills

Manages six to seven inboxes and a significant weekly meeting load while keeping daily reconciliations current



Non-Negotiables



Follows documented procedures exactly, every time

Treats every error as a lesson — the same mistake shouldn't happen twice

Improves the system rather than working around it, and flags a better way of doing something

Fully focused during work hours, with zero tolerance for outside work

Calm under volume, handling daily reconciliations, fortnightly payroll and multiple inboxes without quality slipping

Discreet with payroll and staff financial data — confidentiality is essential



Working Arrangements



Full-time, under the direction of the main accountant

Completes payroll-week workload within contracted hours (no ongoing overtime expected)

Comfortable working where documentation is still being refined, without being thrown in before ready



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of a critical finance function, with zero-error payroll as a clear, respected standard

Room to shape and improve checklists and systems, not just follow them

Join a business growing from 60 towards 100 employees, with the role scaling alongside it

A team culture built on people looking after people, where attitude and integrity are valued as much as skill



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly.

title: URGENT: Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant – Airbnb & Guest Operations
description:
We are a growing short term rental company looking for an experienced Short Term Rental Virtual Assistant with a strong background in Airbnb and vacation rental operations.



This is not an entry level VA position. We are looking for someone who already understands the day to day operations of short term rentals and can confidently handle guest communication, coordinate cleaners and maintenance, manage issues during active reservations, and work across Airbnb and other booking platforms.



We are also looking for someone who can bring something valuable to our team. We want a person who does more than complete assigned tasks.The right candidate takes initiative, notices problems, suggests solutions, shares ideas from previous experience, and helps us improve our operations as we grow. 



The ideal person is organized, resourceful, dependable, calm under pressure, and able to take ownership of situations without needing constant direction.



SCHEDULE

All working hours are in Pacific Time.

Monday: Off, but attendance at the weekly team meeting at 4:30 PM Pacific Time is required

Tuesday: Off

Wednesday: 5:00 PM to 12:00 AM

Thursday: 5:00 PM to 12:00 AM

Friday: 5:30 PM to 2:00 AM

Saturday: 5:30 PM to 2:00 AM

Sunday: Off



Because this position covers evening operations, you must be consistently available for the entire scheduled shift.

RESPONSIBILITIES



- Managing guest communication before, during, and after reservations

- Responding to Airbnb, VRBO, direct booking, and other OTA guest messages

- Handling questions regarding check in, check out, property access, WiFi, parking, house rules, amenities, and the property

- Troubleshooting guest concerns and finding appropriate solutions quickly

- Coordinating cleaners, maintenance technicians, handymen, pool and spa vendors, and other service providers

- Following up with vendors until maintenance issues are completely resolved

- Coordinating turnovers and communicating with cleaners regarding property readiness, missing supplies, damages, and            cleaning issues

- Monitoring same day check ins and making sure properties are ready before guest arrival

- Handling urgent situations that may occur during a guest stay and escalating issues when necessary

- Documenting maintenance issues, guest i
, expenses, and follow ups

- Assisting with damage claims and reimbursement documentation when needed

- Updating internal task management systems and operational notes

- Following company SOPs while using good judgment when unexpected situations arise

- Providing clear and complete handovers to the next team member

 - Please include the word MY HAPPY PLACE  in your subject so we know you read the entire job post and pay attention to details. 

- Following up on open tasks instead of assuming someone else will handle them



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- We want someone who can bring real value to the team.

- You should be someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for step by step instructions.

- You notice recurring problems and suggest practical solutions.

- You identify gaps in processes, SOPs, guest communication, or property operations.

- You bring useful ideas and knowledge from your previous Airbnb or short term rental experience.

- You think ahead and anticipate possible guest, cleaning, maintenance, or operational issues.

- You are comfortable sharing suggestions and constructive feedback with management.

- You look for ways to make the team more efficient, organized, and consistent.

- You can independently troubleshoot situations while knowing when something needs to be escalated.

- You help prevent problems instead of only reacting after something goes wrong.

- You are interested in growing with the company and taking on more responsibility over time.



We value initiative. If you see a better way to handle something, we want you to speak up. We want someone who can learn and follow our systems while also bringing their own experience, ideas, and strengths to the team.



REQUIREMENTS



Strong previous experience working as an Airbnb or short term rental VA

Experience independently managing guest communication

Experience coordinating cleaners, maintenance technicians, and vendors

Experience with Airbnb and preferably VRBO, 
, and other OTAs

Experience working with property management systems or short term rental software

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent attention to detail

Strong problem solving skills

Ability to manage several active situations without losing track of important details

Ability to remain professional and calm when dealing with difficult guests or urgent property issues

Reliable computer and high speed internet connection

Reliable backup internet and power plan

Ability to work the full Pacific Time schedule listed above

Ability to attend the Monday team meeting at 4:30 PM Pacific Time

Experience with Hostaway, Breezeway, 
, PriceLabs, smart locks, Ring, Minut, or similar short term rental tools is a plus.



COMPENSATION:

$4 per hour 



MONTHLY BONUS STRUCTURE

In addition to regular compensation, we offer a monthly bonus structure.

25 dollars per month for doing a great job in your position and consistently meeting expectations.

50 dollars per month for successfully completing a special monthly bonus task that we will establish together each month.

The monthly bonus task may involve improving a process, completing a project, solving an operational issue, creating a useful system, or contributing something valuable to the team.

This gives you the opportunity to earn up to 75 dollars in additional bonuses each month.



TO APPLY

Send your CV link, make sure we have view access.



We value people who are dependable, proactive, organized, resourceful, and willing to take ownership of their work. We are looking for someone interested in a long term position who wants to grow with our company as our short term rental portfolio expands.

title: Technical Graphic Designer
description:
Threadheads is an Australian graphic tee and apparel brand. We run a print-on-demand model and release licensed and original drops all the time. We're looking for a Technical Graphic Designer to prepare our print files and product mockups. This role mixes design with technical work. It suits someone who likes a steady flow of work and still catches the small things.



What you'll do:



Print file preparation



Create size variants, rip them to ARX format and bulk upload the files to Google Cloud

Fix print file errors quickly and flag any repeat issues to the production lead

Help automate and streamline the process, including moving steps into our ERP



Product templating



Template new designs onto our Photoshop mockups (hoodies and oversized, classic, ringer and washed tees)

Adjust scale, placement and proportions so each print looks realistic

QC every image against the original artwork and keep your exports organised and correctly named



What we're looking for:



Strong Photoshop skills, especially with large layered PSDs and mockup templates

A good eye for design, including design weighting and garment proportions

Sharp attention to detail: you notice watermarks, wrong artwork and low-res files

Reliable and accurate in high-volume, repetitive work

Comfortable with cloud storage and ERP systems

Bonus: Illustrator, Figma, or DTG/RIP software experience



Requirements



A powerful computer that can handle 5GB+ PSD files

A reliable internet connection



To apply

Send a short intro, your portfolio or mockup samples, and your computer specs. Start your message with the word "ARTBOARD" so we know you read the whole listing.

title: Part-Time Video Editor | Premiere Pro | Potential to Grow Full-Time
description:
Part-Time Video Editor | Premiere Pro | Potential to Grow Full-Time



Appalachian Media is looking for a part-time video editor to help create Instagram Reels, real estate videos, and occasional wedding and concert content. We’re starting at approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to grow into a full-time role quickly as our workload increases.



What you’ll work on:

Edit short, engaging Instagram Reels from footage and creative direction we provide.

Create real estate videos that show each property clearly and keep the pacing strong.

Assist with wedding films and concert recaps, including footage selection, syncing audio, and rough cuts.

Organize footage and deliver clean, editable project files for our final review and finishing.

Adobe Premiere Pro is required. Some assignments will be rough cuts that we finish ourselves, so you must be comfortable sharing Premiere project files with organized timelines and properly linked media. Experience working with proxy footage is a plus.



We’re looking for someone with a good sense of story and pacing who can choose the strongest shots, remove shaky or out-of-focus footage, and take feedback well. You should be comfortable editing both vertical and horizontal video and communicating clearly about deadlines and progress.



To apply, please send:

A link to your portfolio, including at least one Instagram Reel or other short-form edit.

Any real estate, wedding, or concert work you’ve edited.

Your experience with Premiere Pro and sharing project files with another editor.

We’ll start with a paid test project to make sure the workflow is a good fit for both of us.
